mapper.sql: i.id, i.user_id, i.course_id, i.title, i.status, i.created_at, c.title AS course_title, u.name AS user_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_inquiries ( id, user_id, course_id, title, content, status, answer, answered_by, answered_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{courseId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{answer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{answeredBy, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{answeredAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, course_id, title, content, status, answer, answered_by, answered_at, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_inquiries WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_inquiries SET status = #{status}, answer = #{answer}, answered_by = #{answeredBy}, answered_at = #{answeredAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
